issue_context.title: lightning: adapt the new dynamic region feature
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

[Dynamic Regions](https://github.com/tikv/rfcs/pull/82) ([Tracking Issue](https://github.com/tikv/tikv/issues/11515)) brings the ability to support region size up to GiB for TiKV.

Lightning will pre-split regions before importing encoded kv data to TiKV. The regions will be split according to region-split-size and region-split-keys and the encoded kvs size.

If the dynamic region is enabled, when importing, we should adjust lightning's region-split-size and region-split-keys with tikv's region configuration to make sure lightning does not split small regions.

review_comments: I think it's too risky to use the huge split keys and split size by default.
those code seems more like adjusting, maybe move into `config.Adjust()`
These codes are adjusting. However it's a bit hard to put them in `config.Adjust()` because some extra instances are needed. Maybe left a TODO here and refactor this in the next PR?
